artworks.title: Untitled (Kingston Church)
artworks.dimensions:
image:  350 x 404 mm
sheet:  406 x 563 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a large church building with a grand entrance, ornate arches framing the door, geometric designs on the facade, slender trees flanking the scene, and a distant building with a bell tower and visible bells on its roof. The sky is lightly sketched, and the horizon is obscured by the buildings. The artwork uses a monochromatic color palette of shades of gray to convey form and depth, with textured brushstrokes and pathways leading the eye through the composition.

artworks.title: Moonlit Stroll in Winter
artworks.dimensions:
image:  374 x 277 mm
paper:  557 x 458 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a winter landscape with a meandering stream flowing into the distance. Leafless trees, snow-covered buildings, and a distant church spire are visible against an overcast sky. The scene is created using meticulous brushstrokes, with a monochromatic color palette dominated by grayscale tones. Snowy banks and leafless shrubs contrast with darker trunks and shaded areas, creating depth. In the distance, two figures can be seen walking among denser trees with more shadow, adding texture and dimension.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterfront scene with a horizon at the top third of the image, showing a range of hills meeting the sky. The landscape has delicate brushstrokes creating an ethereal quality. A building with docks and masts, a post in the water, moored boats with sails, and distant slender structures can be seen. The color palette is muted, with shades of sepia and brown, giving a vintage feel.

artworks.title: An Old Courtyard (New Orleans)
artworks.dimensions:
plate:   242 x 175 mm
sheet:  335 x 265 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural courtyard scene. The courtyard has various structural elements including a wooden balcony with a lattice design on the left, stairs leading up to it, a large window on the right showing an interior space, and a partially open door below the window. In the foreground, there is a wooden table with containers. The scene suggests everyday life in a historical or old-world environment.

artworks.title: Untitled (Farm Scene)
artworks.dimensions:
image:  252 x 188 mm
sheet:   306 x 236 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a barnyard scene with ducks and geese. The image depicts a gathering of various birds near the entrance of a barn. In the darkened barn interior, light streams in from an open doorway, illuminating the birds as they appear to be congregating or being shooed out. Feathers and farm tools are scattered around, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: A New England Road
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a shepherd and his flock of sheep moving along a dirt path. The sheep are close together, displaying detailed textures of their woolly coats. A dog accompanies the shepherd. A stone wall borders the path, with lush grasses and bushes on the right. In the distance, the land rises gently with scattered trees across rolling hills. The horizon is low, and the sky has swirling clouds. The color palette is limited to black and beige, resembling an etching.

artworks.title: Untitled (Love Me, Love Me Not)
artworks.dimensions:
image:  456 x 751 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:   629 x 916 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman sitting in a grassy field with her body mostly visible. She is sitting with her elbows on her knees and her hands clasped near her face. She has delicate facial features, slightly wavy hair under a bonnet, and is wearing dark-colored clothing with an apron. Several geese are foraging and drinking from a stream nearby. The background includes tall grass, a fence, and scattered shrubs under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Untitled (New York Landscape)
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape viewed from an elevated position. There are trees at the horizon, and the sky fills the upper half with clouds. The foreground has detailed textures like branches and foliage, while the background hints at structures and grazing animals. The artwork is primarily monochromatic, emphasizing brushwork and textures in the serene scene.

artworks.title: After a Good Day's Sport
artworks.artist: Stephen James Ferris after Felix Octavius Carr Darley
artworks.dimensions:
image:  211 x 285 mm
sheet:   267 x 393 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a rifle sitting against a tree, looking at two bears lying on rocks. Beside him, a donkey with supplies stands. The scene is filled with dense forestation and there is no visible horizon line. The artwork features intricate detailing, particularly in the textures of the trees and animals. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white to create depth. The background is a dense forest with twisted branches and foliage.

artworks.title: A Rainy Night, Madison Square
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and roulette on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a nighttime urban scene from a street-level perspective. The horizon is implied by distant buildings and streetcars above reflections on wet pavement. Buildings are outlined with a larger shadowed building in the center. Brushstrokes create a sense of blurred motion and mist with diagonal rain-like strokes. The color palette is mostly monochromatic, with shades of charcoal and black. Reflections show limited light sources like street lamps and signs. In the distance, figures with umbrellas and horse-drawn carriages provide scale and life to the scene.

artworks.title: The Signal of Distress
artworks.medium: photogravure in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 443 x 696 mm (17 7/16 x 27 3/8 in.)
Primary sheet: 509 x 750 mm (20 1/16 x 29 1/2 in.)
Secondary sheet: 575 x 825 mm (22 5/8 x 32 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from the deck of a ship. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing figures engaged in activity. The horizon aligns with the ship's railing, revealing the rough ocean. The detailing is realistic, especially in the figures and equipment. The color scheme is monochromatic, with shades of gray and brown. A group of sailors in rain gear is preparing or securing a lifeboat. The sea and sky blend in the background.

artworks.title: Untitled (Cows And Calves By A Stream)
artworks.dimensions:
image:  750 x 572 mm
sheet:  870 x 645 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is marked by a strip of land with partly cloudy sky above it. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, adding depth and texture to the trees and cattle. A cluster of cows and a calf are gathered on a dirt path beside a small stream, surrounded by lush vegetation. The color palette consists of sepia tones. In the distance, more cows graze in a field lined with trees.

artworks.title: Shrewsbury River
artworks.dimensions:
image: 290 x 432 mm
sheet:  439 x 582 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a river flowing through it. In the foreground, there is a small boat on the water, and in the background, sailboats are docked near a strip of land. Tall trees with sparse foliage are on the right side, with a structure nestled among them near the water. The horizon is slightly above the center of the image, with a calm sky above it. The brushstrokes vary in texture, with fine strokes for the sky and water and more detailed strokes for the trees. The color palette is muted, with sepia and gray tones creating a peaceful atmosphere. Birds are scattered in the sky.

artworks.title: Old Trees at Naushon Island [plate 2]
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed etching of a cluster of gnarled trees with twisted and barren branches. The horizon is not visible, focusing tightly on the trees. The etching shows fine lines defining textures of trees and grass, creating a stippled effect. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white for contrast. Birds are seen in the sky, adding movement to the scene. The background is minimal with faint clouds or mist, suggesting a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Duck Pond
artworks.dimensions:
image:  187 x 254 mm
sheet:   267 x 348 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a pond with ducks swimming in it. In the background, there are dense, textured foliage in various shades of gray. A small wooden shed is off-center to the left, with a wooden fence extending from it towards the water. The ducks are swimming calmly, and the overall color palette is black and gray.

artworks.title: The New Moon
artworks.dimensions:
image:  334 x 503 mm
sheet:   541 x 645 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a lower perspective angle looking down a path surrounded by tall trees, leading to a calm body of water. The horizon shows a rise of land with scattered trees and shrubs. The etching technique creates detailed lines for texture, capturing the natural landscape. The monochromatic color palette uses shades of gray and black, showing a serene setting under a crescent moon in the sky and reflected on the water. A path winds through grass towards clustered trees.

artworks.title: Untitled (Coastal Scene)
artworks.dimensions:
image:  307 x 570 mm
sheet:   405 x 666 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This black and white etching uses variations of dark ink and light paper to depict a rural landscape with a dirt path leading toward a cluster of houses and a windmill. On the right, a body of water with grassy banks. There is a small wooden dock in the foreground. Before the wooden dock sits a beached wooden rowboat with a curved hull, small in size. In the body of water sits a sailboat with a single tall mast and triangular sail, and farther back a larger sailing ship with multiple masts and a wider body. On the left, a stone wall surrounded by trees borders the path. In the distance, several buildings with sloped roofs sit amongst the trees, with a tall windmill rising above them and wispy smoke drifting from the chimneys. The shoreline slopes gently down to the water, where tall grass leans to the viewer’s right around a simple dock. The dock is covered by the grass, and you can barely see an old wooden fence peek above the shoreline grass. On the left, above the trees, is a bell tower placed almost directly over the stone wall on the left side of the path. The path winds toward a tall tree. In almost the center is a small wooden paddle boat tied to the shoreline. In the distance, an island is behind the larger sailing ship. Past the island a few small boats barely visible on the horizon. The bay and the background blend into each other because they are the same tone and the faint horizon line. The sky is empty but blends into the bay.

artworks.title: Untitled (Pastorale Scene with Sawmill)
artworks.dimensions:
image:  329 x 653 mm 
sheet:   441 x 752 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a stream reflecting trees, a bridge, a horse with a rider in a fenced area, a barn, and distant buildings. The sky occupies a significant portion of the upper area with faint clouds. The painting is detailed, with fine brushstrokes capturing textures of leaves, wood, and stones. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Halt of the Line of Battle
artworks.dimensions:
image:  276 x 406 mm
sheet:  320 x 500 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of soldiers standing in formation from an elevated perspective. The horizon is low in the image, with trees and distant figures in the background. The brushwork resembles etching or cross-hatching, with a monochromatic brown color palette. Closest to us are fallen bodies on the ground, with small groups of figures and horses visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Fall in for Soup
artworks.dimensions:
image:  279 x 402 mm
sheet:  317 x 498 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a military encampment scene with orderly arrangements of tents and figures engaged in daily activities. In the foreground, there is a group of people standing in a line next to a makeshift kitchen area suspended over a fire or cooking station. Behind them, a variety of tents are aligned in neat rows. Smoke rises from some chimneys. Further back, a team of horse-drawn wagons is making their way in a line, adding depth to the scene. The background shows gentle hills, scattered trees, and a lightly etched sky. The line-work and shading emphasize the details of the figures and surroundings, capturing the essence of life within a historical military camp.

artworks.title: The Pontoon Bridges
artworks.dimensions:
image:  279 x 405 mm
sheet:  320 x 500 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view of a winding road and river below. The horizon is at the upper third, where the road and a line of trees meet the sky. A dense forest separates the sky from the land. The scene includes soldiers and covered wagons crossing a bridge over a river. The bridge has a line of people and wagons stretching into the distance. The road turns and ascends a grassy hill with trees. The image uses fine lines to show texture and detail of the landscape, figures, and water. The color palette is limited to sepia tones, emphasizing a historical context and contrast in the scene. Close to us, the ground is textured with tree stumps and foliage.

artworks.title: After the Storm
artworks.dimensions:
image:  365 x 461 mm
sheet:   469 x 571 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a sailing vessel navigating rough waters. The boat is tilted, and two figures work on deck. In the background, there is a shipwreck and seabirds flying around. The sky is filled with swirling clouds, painted with fine brushstrokes in shades of gray and black, creating a dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Wedding Ring
artworks.dimensions:
plate:  597 x 337 mm
image:  502 x 261 mm
sheet:  638 x 498 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a man. The woman is standing with her head bowed, looking down. She has closed eyes, delicate facial features, and styled hair with a clip. She wears a long dress with puffed sleeves and lace detail. The man is leaning against a piece of furniture and looking intently at the woman. He has medium-length hair and wears a garment with intricate patterns. The setting features a patterned wall and geometric tile flooring, suggesting a historical period.
